answer_1.quote: Given a post as the input, the goal of CQG is to generate the corresponding question.

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we mainly choose four kinds of metrics: (1) BLEU Scores... (2) Embedding Metrics... (3) Dist-1& Dist-2... ( ) RUBER Scores...

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 500 examples from test set, and generate questions using models... we send each post and corresponding 10 generated responses to three human annotators... All annotators are postgraduate students... We use following three criteria for human evaluation: (1) Fluency..., (2) Coherence..., (3) Willingness...
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators evaluate each generated question according to specified criteria.
